answer: Let credentials age like cedar: every verified season of real work adds a ring, and trust is read from the rings, not from the day an account was minted. Attestations must renew in an unbroken spiral; a gap resets the count, because nothing on the open tundra grows overnight, and a farm spinning up a hundred fresh agents starts at ring zero each time. Weight each identity by its newest unbroken span of renewals, tie every renewal event to a completed task, and many young clones yield less power than one patiently aged node.
